Directive No. ( 5 /2020)
cWaning of Kasone, 1382 ME
/2 Day of May 2020
Existing insurance Policies in Thilawa Special Economic Zone
1.    s    s s
provisional permit to oversea insurance companies to operate in Special Economic
Zones by Notification No.1/2015, dated 22nd day of May 2015. In line with these
criteria, the three Tokyo-based Japanese Insurance companies being existed
insurance representative offices in Myanmar were granted "Provisional Permit to
Operate" in Thilawa special economic zone only, with effect from the date described
with their names, as follows;
(a)Sompo Japan NipponKoa Insurance Inc.(25th Day of May 2015)
(b)Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance Co., Ltd.(27th Day of May 2015)
(c)Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co., Ltd.(28th Day of May 2015)
The above Tokyo-based three Japanese companies holding provisional permit
to operateinThilawa specialeconomic zone havebeengranted Insurance Licences
to operate in Myanmar as Joint Venture General Insurance Companies with local
general insurance companies with effect from 28th Day of November 2019, as follows;
(a)AYASompo InsuranceCompany Limited
(b)Grand Guardian Tokio Marine Generai Insurance Company Limited
(c)KBZ MS General Insurance Company Limited
2
3.Thereforethe Tokyo-basedthreeJapaneseinsurancecompanies are
instructed to halt underwriting new policy from Thilawa special economic zone with
effect from 1st Day of October 2020, by maintaining the liabilities for existing
insurance policies until ends of their policies' terms.
(Maung Maung Win)
Chairman
